summary: We give people who know something useful a place to teach one practical intro class on it, live or recorded, for anyone in the community. Learners leave with something they can use, and they get to know the instructor.
audience: People who keep getting asked about something they know: the go-to person friends bring the same question to, people recently retired from careers like teaching, nursing, accounting or engineering, and coaches and consultants who know their stuff but aren't well known yet. The intro classes are also free and open to anyone in the community who wants to learn.
problem:
Before: they explain the same thing again and again, over coffee, after church, in a group chat. "I know my stuff. I just don't know how to get in front of people." "I don't want all that experience to just sit there."
After: that explanation lives in one intro class anyone in the community can join. People get to know them and see how they teach, and if learners want more, they can build a fuller course later.
moments:
Friends keep bringing them the same question, like how to fix their credit or get a small business loan.
They've recently retired and have years of know-how and some free time.
They're a coach or consultant and few people know them yet.
offerings:
A free intro class you teach on one real question, live, recorded or both
A fuller course later, if learners want more
Free intro classes for anyone in the community who wants to learn
Subjects can include business, careers, money, technology, leadership, health and wellness education, parenting, personal development, or a practical or creative skill
howItRuns:
One practical intro class, live, recorded or both, taught around your work. No teaching background needed: if you can explain it to a friend over coffee, you can teach the intro class.
Which classes are running changes month to month.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team, any time in the next three weeks. If you're under 18, a parent joins it.
After the free call: take your time. If it fits, the team talks you through the next steps for your first class.
faqs:
Q: What do I get out of it?
A: People get to know you and what you know, and we help instructors get seen and build relationships in the community. Nobody can promise you students or income. It depends on you and your subject.

Q: How much time does it take?
A: Right now, just the free 15-minute call. Ask the team then how much time a class usually takes.

Q: Isn't this just a way to sell a course?
A: Each class has to be about a real problem, not about selling a course. Learners decide for themselves whether they want more.

Q: Can I join a class instead of teaching one?
A: Yes. The intro classes are free and open to anyone in the community. Ask on the free call what's on this month.
aboutYou:
I run Verily Academy. We connect people who have useful knowledge and experience with people who can benefit from it. Our instructors are educators, professionals, coaches, entrepreneurs, subject-matter experts and community leaders, and they teach practical classes on real questions and challenges.
We want useful education to be easier to reach, and we want instructors to have a way to build relationships and show what they know. Verily Academy is part of NowTRANSFORMED, a youth leadership development program.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
Never promise instructors students, income or clients.
Don't describe a class as a pitch for a paid course. Each class is about a real problem.
Health and wellness classes are education only: no medical advice or claims.
